value.rationale: The fourth kinematic chord moment is a standard, precisely motivated natural integral-geometric invariant positioned between universal I3 and classically recognized I5. A single side-symmetric expression valid for acute, right, obtuse and near-degenerate triangles removes the four distribution cases and permits direct exact computation without piecewise inversion. An exact equilateral benchmark and independent numeric line integration accompany it. No broader inequality is needed to make this gap-filling exact formula useful, though no new extremal theorem is claimed.
